commonPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE horizontal 3-frame photorealistic fighting-game sprite sheet of {NAME}, using the attached real portrait strictly for face identity. Preserve recognizable exact face, age, hair, skin tone and natural body proportions. This is a fictional satirical video game. Three evenly spaced full-body figures of THE SAME PERSON in THREE EQUAL VERTICAL COLUMNS, all feet on same baseline at 94% image height, head at 8%, same scale across columns. Column 1: three-quarter profile facing RIGHT, relaxed guarded fighting stance, knees slightly bent, fists at chest. Column 2: same person and clothing, punch with right arm extended to the RIGHT, grounded stance. Column 3: same person and clothing, controlled front kick to the RIGHT, standing leg firmly grounded. Full head-to-toe including shoes, comfortable margins, no cut off limbs, no overlapping between columns. CLOTHING: {CLOTHES}. Natural anatomy and age, no bodybuilder muscles, no enlarged heads, realistic skin pores, realistic tailored fabric, natural hair. High-quality photographic digitized arcade sprites, clean studio lighting, subtle cool blue rim light. TRUE TRANSPARENT background and clean alpha edge; no backdrop, no floor, no shadow beneath feet, no text, no labels, no grid, no props, no blood. Wide landscape sheet around 3:2 aspect ratio. Each figure centered horizontally within its own equal-width third so game can crop the three frames.
